definitions.description: Hits may arc to another hostile creature.
definitions.name: Storm Conductor

definitions.description: Credited kills burst around the victim.
definitions.name: Detonation Bloom

definitions.description: Positive damage retaliates against its source.
definitions.name: Thorn Mirror

definitions.description: Movement may shock a nearby hostile creature.
definitions.name: Static Footsteps

definitions.description: Adjacent hostiles hurt in one chain release a burst.
definitions.name: Resonant Wounds

definitions.description: Repeat an attack's locked cells after 200 world time.
definitions.name: Temporal Echo

definitions.description: Slash gains one forward cell and extra damage.
definitions.name: Crescent Reach

definitions.description: Observed enemy friendly fire shocks the aggressor.
definitions.name: Turncoat Spark

definitions.description: Direct hits ignite foes for three 100-time ticks.
definitions.name: Emberbrand

definitions.description: Damage to a Burning foe beside another Burning foe bursts.
definitions.name: Flashpoint

definitions.description: Credited hostile kills restore health.
definitions.name: Grave Dividend

definitions.description: Directly damaging an unhurt foe deals bonus damage.
definitions.name: Opening Cut

definitions.description: Direct hits gain bonus damage per nearby living hostile.
definitions.name: Crowdbreaker

definitions.description: Nearby hostile windups may draw a retaliatory spark.
definitions.name: Harrier's Response

definitions.description: Fully blocked hostile damage retaliates nearby.
definitions.name: Perfect Guard

definitions.description: Direct hits while at 40% health or less spark again.
definitions.name: Final Spark

definitions.description: Enter a tile beside two foes to pulse into both.
definitions.name: Pulse Step

definitions.description: Each disjoint three credited or observed hostile deaths blast.
definitions.name: Packed Powder

definitions.description: Explicit Sword Strike reaches two cells in its line.
definitions.name: Longblade Geometry

definitions.description: Dash strikes each hostile beside its traversed path once.
definitions.name: Phantom Lunge

definitions.description: A fully blocked hostile hit bursts around you.
definitions.name: Guardian's Vow

definitions.description: Collecting currency restores health.
definitions.name: Prospector's Heart

definitions.description: Other boon activations spark a nearby foe.
definitions.name: Circuit Chorus

definitions.description: Direct first strikes ignite unhurt foes for three ticks.
definitions.name: Crownfire

definitions.description: Leaving sticky bog primes your next direct strike with stone damage.
definitions.name: Stonewake
definitions.unit: stone damage on primed strike

definitions.description: A bramble contact lashes a nearby hostile for bonus thorn damage.
definitions.name: Bramble Compact
definitions.unit: thorn damage per bramble contact

definitions.description: Dashing across ice cuts hostiles beside the traversed path.
definitions.name: Froststep Catalyst
definitions.unit: ice damage per path-adjacent foe

definitions.description: Breaking a barricade scatters a one-cell shard burst.
definitions.name: Fracture Dividend
definitions.unit: shard damage in burst

definitions.description: Direct hits from obscuring mist gain surprise damage.
definitions.name: Mist Veil
definitions.unit: bonus mist damage from obscuring tile

definitions.description: Lightning hits beside a resonant crystal arc to another nearby foe.
definitions.name: Crystal Harmony
definitions.unit: bonus lightning arc damage

definitions.description: Repeated direct hits on one foe build a short capped fracture mark.
definitions.name: Sunderer's Mark
definitions.unit: damage at mark count 2–3

definitions.description: A fully blocked hostile hit primes bonus damage on your next special hit.
definitions.name: Counterweight
definitions.unit: bonus special-hit damage after block

definitions.description: Credited kills grant a brief scheduled-action speed surge.
definitions.name: Bloodrush
definitions.unit: temporary speed for 300 world time

definitions.description: Taking real damage primes bonus damage on your next direct hit.
definitions.name: Pain Dividend
definitions.unit: bonus next-hit damage after harm

definitions.description: Direct hits against foes at or below half health cut deeper.
definitions.name: Executioner's Thread
definitions.unit: bonus wounded-target damage

definitions.description: Damaging a Burning foe shares pain with adjacent Burning foes.
definitions.name: Shared Agony
definitions.unit: damage to each adjacent Burning foe

definitions.description: A hostile locking a strike on your cell takes a retaliatory hit.
definitions.name: Windup Hunter
definitions.unit: attacker retaliation damage

definitions.description: Overlapping hostile windups burst around the newest attacker.
definitions.name: Crossfire Omen
definitions.unit: overlap burst damage

definitions.description: A hostile moving closer within six tiles draws a spark.
definitions.name: Pursuit Spark
definitions.unit: approaching-enemy spark damage

definitions.description: Direct hits in a line of three living hostiles gain formation damage.
definitions.name: Ordered Ranks
definitions.unit: formation bonus damage

definitions.description: Hostile damage observed four to nine tiles away sends a distant spark.
definitions.name: Far Witness
definitions.unit: distant witnessed damage

definitions.description: Enemy friendly fire grants a short one-hit damage ward.
definitions.name: Betrayal Ward
definitions.unit: damage absorbed on next positive hit

definitions.description: Moving primes one bonus direct strike; attacks consume the rhythm.
definitions.name: Rhythm of Steel
definitions.unit: bonus next-hit damage after movement

definitions.description: Each three distinct hostiles damaged in one chain release a blast.
definitions.name: Cluster Rupture
definitions.unit: three-target chain burst damage

definitions.description: Ranger Bow Shot branches into two nearby clear hostile cells.
definitions.name: Splitflight
definitions.unit: bow damage bonus; branches stay at two

definitions.description: Ranger Piercing Volley extends one more clear cell.
definitions.name: Recurve
definitions.unit: volley damage bonus; adds one clear cell

definitions.description: Arcanist Fire Sigil gains an outer two-cell ring.
definitions.name: Expanding Sigil
definitions.unit: sigil damage bonus; two-cell ring

definitions.description: Arc Bolt striking Burning links to nearby Burning foes.
definitions.name: Alchemical Flip
definitions.unit: bolt damage bonus; Burning link

definitions.description: Berserker Crushing Blow shocks adjacent cells beyond its first impact.
definitions.name: Earthshaker
definitions.unit: crush damage bonus; adjacent shockwave

definitions.description: Berserker Heavy Lunge primes a stronger next Crushing Blow.
definitions.name: Battle March
definitions.unit: bonus Crush damage after Heavy Lunge

definitions.description: A direct hit bursts across the target's adjacent cells.
definitions.name: Aftershock
definitions.unit: adjacent burst damage before defense

definitions.description: Taking real hostile damage bursts around you.
definitions.name: Reprisal Nova
definitions.unit: nearby retaliation damage before defense

definitions.description: Escape a locked enemy attack; your next direct hit on that foe gains damage.
definitions.name: Ring of Reversal
definitions.unit: bonus damage on the next direct hit against that attacker

definitions.description: Collecting gold at half health or lower grants a one-hit ward for 300 world time.
definitions.name: Beggar's Cap
definitions.unit: damage absorbed on one hit

definitions.description: Wasted food or health healing becomes a one-hit ward for 400 world time, capped by your power. Replaces a smaller ward.
definitions.name: Overflow Chalice
definitions.unit: maximum captured healing

definitions.description: Eating food grants action speed for 300 world time. More food refreshes the duration.
definitions.name: Road Flask
definitions.unit: temporary speed

definitions.description: A health pickup removes Burning and restores additional health. Food does not trigger it.
definitions.name: Field Dressing
definitions.unit: additional health

definitions.description: Eating food stores one recovery charge for 600 world time. Your next Wait spends it to heal; charges do not accumulate.
definitions.name: Ration Reserve
definitions.unit: health from the next charged Wait

definitions.description: A paid chest refunds some gold after purchase, capped by its price. You must afford the full price first.
definitions.name: Broker's Seal
definitions.unit: maximum gold refunded

definitions.description: Your credited kills add gold to their normal currency drop. Summoned or revived reward-exempt foes give no bonus.
definitions.name: Funeral Coin
definitions.unit: extra dropped gold

definitions.description: While aiming an immediate attack, P / LB toggles a vow: pay 2 HP on commit for bonus primary damage before criticals. Must leave at least 1 HP. Cancel is free; movement and utility cannot pay.
definitions.name: Pilgrim's Vow
definitions.unit: bonus primary damage for the 2 HP vow

definitions.description: Each attack rolls one of 8 equal faces: 1 heal, 2 heavy, 3 Burning, 4 ward, 5 arc, 6 burst, skull executes regular foes, cross misses. Bonuses need a hit. Utility never rolls; bosses/specials resist skull.
definitions.name: Fateful Dice
definitions.unit: rolled bonus/heal/ward/tick/burst power

definitions.description: Positive primary hits send a two-cell lance beyond the victim, away from the strike origin. Walls and closed doors stop it.
definitions.name: Linebreaker's Pawn
definitions.unit: pattern damage per cell before defense

definitions.description: Cardinal primary hits send two cells in both perpendicular directions from the victim. It rewards lining up a row of foes.
definitions.name: Rook's Wake
definitions.unit: pattern damage per cell before defense

definitions.description: Diagonal primary hits release four diagonal two-cell rays from the victim. Stone corners block each ray.
definitions.name: Bishop's Wake
definitions.unit: pattern damage per cell before defense

definitions.description: Positive special-attack hits strike the eight L-shaped endpoints around the victim. At least one clear two-leg route is required; adjacent cells are spared.
definitions.name: Knight's Gambit
definitions.unit: pattern damage per cell before defense

definitions.description: Credited hostile kills strike a hollow ring two tiles from the victim. The inner ring is spared, and walls block the outer ring.
definitions.name: Hollow Crown
definitions.unit: pattern damage per cell before defense

definitions.description: Wait sends four cardinal rays two cells from your current tile. It spends ordinary Wait time, hits no diagonals and stops at walls.
definitions.name: Crosswind
definitions.unit: pattern damage per cell before defense

definitions.description: Positive special-attack hits strike a three-cell forward fan beyond the victim. Walls and stone corners block it.
definitions.name: Fan of Blades
definitions.unit: pattern damage per cell before defense

definitions.description: A committed Dash locks a five-cell cross at its starting tile, striking after 150 world time. Utility movement and beacon returns do not trigger it.
definitions.name: Backtrail Mantle
definitions.unit: pattern damage per cell before defense

definitions.description: Positive special hits on regular foes in your row or column deal bonus damage, then pull surviving victims one cardinal cell toward you. Occupied cells, exits and walls stop the pull.
definitions.name: Grasping Hand
definitions.unit: bonus damage before one-cell pull

definitions.description: Basic hits against cardinal-adjacent regular foes push them one cell. If the push is blocked, deal collision damage instead. A successful push interrupts a windup; bosses are exempt.
definitions.name: Anchor Maul
definitions.unit: collision damage when the one-cell push is blocked

definitions.description: A positive primary hit briefly stuns the first surviving regular foe. One trigger per attack, then a 400-time cooldown. Stun caps at 100 time; it never gives a guaranteed player reaction action.
definitions.name: Hourglass Clasp
definitions.unit: stun time, capped at 100; cooldown 400

definitions.description: Wait while hurt spends active one-hit wards to restore health, up to your power. Consumed wards lose unused capacity. Empty wards and full health cannot trigger it.
definitions.name: Ward Ledger
definitions.unit: maximum health recovered by spending wards

definitions.description: A primary hit on an already Burning foe consumes its remaining Burning for one immediate fire hit, capped by your power. The queued ticks are removed; normal defenses still apply.
definitions.name: Cinder Stopper
definitions.unit: maximum captured remaining Burning damage

definitions.description: Wait gathers pickups from up to four adjacent cardinal tiles, limited by power, in north/east/south/west order. Requires clear visible ground; full-health food and carried drops stay put. Normal pickup effects apply.
definitions.name: Scavenger's Hook
definitions.unit: adjacent pickup tiles gathered per Wait, capped at four

definitions.description: Adventurer: aimed F also strikes the clear cell directly behind you. Both sides share one primary batch. Bump remains forward-only; F gains bonus damage.
definitions.name: Pommel Return
definitions.unit: bonus primary damage before criticals and defense

definitions.description: Ranger: aimed F pierces creatures along its four-cell clear line. Existing Splitflight branches still work. Bump keeps first-contact behavior; F gains bonus damage.
definitions.name: Needle Flight
definitions.unit: bonus primary damage before criticals and defense

definitions.description: Arcanist: a fully placed R fire sigil spares its center and strengthens the surrounding cells. Expanding Sigil keeps its outer ring. Short blocked casts retain their normal travel cells.
definitions.name: Hollow Sigil
definitions.unit: bonus primary damage before criticals and defense

definitions.description: Berserker: R cleave also strikes its three clear rear neighbors, completing the surrounding arc on open ground. Normal deliberate recovery remains; R gains bonus damage.
definitions.name: Backswing
definitions.unit: bonus primary damage before criticals and defense

definitions.description: Sentinel: R instead strikes the four two-step cardinal tiles and four diagonal neighbors. Cardinal-adjacent tiles are spared. Walls and corners block the stronger pulse.
definitions.name: Distant Bastion
definitions.unit: bonus primary damage before criticals and defense

definitions.description: Alchemist: F splashes a one-cell cardinal cross at its first creature contact. Empty shots keep the normal line. Clear travel cells and normal recovery remain; F gains bonus damage.
definitions.name: Volatile Vial
definitions.unit: bonus primary damage before criticals and defense

definitions.description: Duelist: aimed F keeps its first step, then forks into two clear side endpoints instead of the straight second cell. Walls and corners stop each branch. Bump stays narrow; F gains bonus damage.
definitions.name: Split Thrust
definitions.unit: bonus primary damage before criticals and defense

definitions.description: Each disjoint group of three different foes damaged by one primary attack restores health. Repeated damage to one victim cannot count again in that attack chain.
definitions.name: Threefold Remedy
definitions.unit: health per three distinct primary victims

definitions.description: Two different credited, reward-eligible kills in one causal chain grant a one-hit ward for 300 world time. Summoned and revived reward-exempt foes cannot count.
definitions.name: Twin Seals
definitions.unit: damage absorbed by the one-hit ward

definitions.description: Each group of four different other triggered boons in one causal chain restores health. Repeated activations of one boon do not count again; passive weapon forms are not triggered activations.
definitions.name: Fourfold Ledger
definitions.unit: health per four different triggered boons

definitions.description: Positive primary hits gain bonus damage when the victim is in your row or column and a wall, closed door or blocking object is immediately behind it, away from you.
definitions.name: Stone Backstop
definitions.unit: bonus pinned-victim damage before defense

definitions.description: A fully blocked primary attack against a surviving regular foe grants a one-hit ward. One trigger per attack, with a 300-world-time cooldown; bosses and exempt foes do not qualify.
definitions.name: Borrowed Guard
definitions.unit: damage absorbed by the one-hit ward

definitions.description: Your Burning applications add remaining ticks, capped at eight total. Tick power, interval and the already queued next tick do not change. More copies add ticks up to that cap.
definitions.name: Long Wick
definitions.unit: additional Burning ticks; eight total maximum

definitions.description: Credited reward-eligible kills of Burning foes ignite the nearest other foe within three clear tiles for two ticks. Ordinary ancestry guards prevent an endless automatic fire chain.
definitions.name: Passing Ember
definitions.unit: passed Burning damage per tick before defense

definitions.description: Actually cleansing Burning from you releases a one-cell fire burst around you. Empty cleansing attempts and consuming a foe's Burning cannot trigger it.
definitions.name: Purging Seal
definitions.unit: cleansing burst damage per cell before defense

definitions.description: Opening a closed door grants a one-hit ward for 400 world time. Walking through an already open door cannot renew it.
definitions.name: Doorward Lamp
definitions.unit: damage absorbed by the door-opening ward

definitions.description: Your actual discovery of a secret restores health once. Revealed secrets cannot be harvested again; inspecting the map is free and gives no healing.
definitions.name: Secret Apple
definitions.unit: health per newly discovered secret

definitions.description: Claiming a paid chest grants a one-hit ward for 600 world time. The full price is still required; free secret and elite rewards do not count.
definitions.name: Spoils Aegis
definitions.unit: damage absorbed by the purchased ward

definitions.description: Wait while hurt on obscuring mist to recover health, at most once per 400 world time. Wait still advances enemies and committed attacks normally.
definitions.name: Mist Lullaby
definitions.unit: health from a mist rest; cooldown 400

definitions.description: Leaving glazed ice grants a one-hit ward for 200 world time. Staying on ice or moving between ordinary floor tiles cannot renew it.
definitions.name: Rime Disk
definitions.unit: damage absorbed after leaving ice

definitions.description: Entering a heat vent grants a one-hit ward for 200 world time, at most once per 200 time. The vent keeps its locked timing and normal damage; standing still cannot renew the ward.
definitions.name: Vent Mantle
definitions.unit: damage absorbed by the vent-entry ward

definitions.description: Fully blocking a hostile direct attack stores one charge for 400 world time. Your next paid Wait spends it on a one-cell burst; empty waiting cannot create another charge.
definitions.name: Patient Rebuke
definitions.unit: damage from the charged Wait burst before defense

definitions.description: Wayfinder: returning to your beacon sends two-cell cardinal rays from the actual landing. Walls stop the rays, diagonals are spared, and ordinary Dashes cannot trigger them.
definitions.name: Beacon Afterglow
definitions.unit: beacon-landing ray damage before defense

definitions.description: Tinkerer: deploying or replacing your sentry grants action speed for 200 world time. It does not add sentry shots or make autonomous bolts trigger other boons.
definitions.name: Sentry Quartermaster
definitions.unit: temporary deployment speed

definitions.description: Spiritbinder: placing or repositioning your spirit grants a one-hit ward for 150 world time. Commanded strikes do not renew it; the spirit never becomes a shield entity.
definitions.name: Spirit Shelter
definitions.unit: damage absorbed by the positioning ward

definitions.description: Stormcaller: actually grounding stored charge with Dash adds a one-hit damage ward for 300 world time behind your normal grounding shield. An uncharged Dash gives no ward.
definitions.name: Grounding Rod
definitions.unit: damage absorbed after the grounding shield

definitions.description: Reflecting your own attack from an enemy mirror restores health once per attack. Failed reflection, enemy fire and automatic class shots cannot heal you.
definitions.name: Mirror Dividend
definitions.unit: health per real reflected manual attack
